text: Never chase a hot listing like Jio. Here's the math, two weeks later.
The IPO price was eleven nineteen rupees. On day one, it listed at thirteen fifty eight. Twenty one percent up.
Today it trades near fourteen fourteen. That's twenty six percent above the IPO price.
The first results were strong. Profit, eight thousand three hundred crore, up fourteen percent. And five hundred forty two million users.
But it's not cheap anymore. You now pay forty one times its yearly profit.
My take? Hot listings often cool down. If I were buying, I'd go slowly, in small parts, not all at once.
Would you buy Jio now, or wait? Comment JIO, and follow for the next one.
